message.reasoning_content: We need to output JSON with lesson and final_answer. Lesson should state key distinguishing feature: production and sale of counterfeit (fake) drugs vs illegal production/sale of drugs (without license). The case involves using unlicensed production, repackaging, labeling, selling counterfeit (假药). The wrong label was "非法生产、买卖药品" which is generic illegal production/sale of drugs, but correct is "生产、销售假药" because the drugs are counterfeit (no proper approval, false labeling). So lesson: key is presence of false labeling/ counterfeit nature. Rule: if facts show repackaging, false labeling, no license, and selling as genuine, label as 生产、销售假药. Provide JSON.
